selection_rationale: Covers the Pro Tools HD/HDX chain found in pro studios and BTS teaching (HDX card, HD I/O, MTRX Studio, Sync X), the USB/Thunderbolt interfaces students actually use (Scarlett 2i2, iD14 MKII, Apollo Twin X, Babyface Pro FS) up to rack units with ADAT/MADI/word clock (Fireface 802 FS, UFX III, MOTU 828), multichannel DB25 converters (Orion 32+, Aurora(n)), Dante network interfaces (Digiface Dante, RedNet X2P), a PCIe MADI card, and three master clocks (OCX HD, MC-3+, Sync X). Picks favour devices whose connectors teach distinct signal lessons (DB25, ADAT, MADI SC vs BNC, AES, word clock termination, Dante redundancy, PoE).
